lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high, as no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Split-screen redesigns for adoption persona selection significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Adding new screens, photo quality hints, setup checklists, or wait indicators showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in steps, layout redesigns, copy updates, and path choice redesigns showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Card Layout Redesign for Path Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a card layout with distinct visuals for premade pet adoption vs custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users with an average wait time of 514s, indicating confusion between custom vs standard pet paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-adopt companion or build a unique pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection screen using a card layout while maintaining functionality.

candidates.score_note: Path layout redesigns showed negative historical lift (-1.3%).

candidates.title: Account Reset Warning Hint on Sign-In
candidates.change: Add clear inline hint text on the sign-in screen warning users to use the same account to keep their existing pets.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after users sign in again with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to preserve existing pets and saved custom data.

guard.reason: Adds helpful sign-in hint text without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high email volume (8 tickets) with low-cost copy change.

candidates.title: Pet Name and Trait Review Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming and trait summary screen right before the adoption certificate is generated.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the flow (60.9%) and takes a median of 89s, showing a need for a clear confirmation step.

new_pet_summary.headline: Review Your Companion Details
new_pet_summary.body: Confirm your pet's name and personality before official adoption.

guard.reason: Adds a valid pet summary screen within onboarding while preserving required steps.

candidates.score_note: New screens add friction and historically harm completion (-9.1%).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Right Before Waiting Generation
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen after pet choice and photo upload, immediately prior to the rendering waiting screen.
candidates.why: Signing in before choosing a pet causes friction; moving sign-in right before account save captures full context after pet setup.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step within onboarding, which is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in showed negative lift (-1.7%) in past tests.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Render Check Flow
candidates.change: Insert a desktop preview check flow during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions before finish.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling on startup.

new_desktop_check.headline: Desktop Visibility Test
new_desktop_check.body: Verifying your screen permissions to display your pet seamlessly on top of desktop windows.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop render check screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Desktop permission flows and background alerts worsen conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut and Control Banner on Final Welcome
candidates.change: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly explain system tray access, hotkeys, and how to summon/hide the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support messages report confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and 4 report desktop feature misbehavior.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for the pet icon in your system tray to access settings, hide/show the companion, or trigger interactions.

guard.reason: Updates home intro screen copy within onboarding guidelines.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update addressing multiple user confusion tickets.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Layout on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Switch the waiting screen to a story scroll layout displaying pet lore and setup status while generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s) with an 18.7% dropoff rate before landing on home.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen while retaining its core function of showing pet generation status.

candidates.score_note: Wait info changes showed consistent slight positive lift (+2.1%).

candidates.title: Pet Care Starter Pack Incentive on Pick Friend
candidates.change: Display a badge component highlighting an included starter accessory pack with every chosen pet.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9%, needing an added incentive to encourage users through choice screens.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free', violating Rule 3 prohibition on price/discount/free extra mentions.

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Alert Notification on Waiting
candidates.change: Add an explicit system notification flag on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app during pet generation.
candidates.why: Users spend over 3 minutes median on the waiting screen, leading to high dropoff without notification assurance.

waiting.hint: You can minimize this window. We'll alert you when your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds notification toggle and hint text to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Desktop system notifications significantly dropped conversion (-6.9%).

candidates.title: Full-Bleed Layout Redesign of Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Transform the home_intro completion screen into a full-bleed layout featuring interactive mascot elements and clear tray guidance.
candidates.why: 64.8% finish conversion shows significant dropoff on the final screen; a dynamic full-bleed presentation boosts completion confidence.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active. Right-click the system tray icon anytime for controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro layout within onboarding scope without losing functionality.

candidates.score_note: Finish redesigns showed minor positive historical lift (+0.7%).
